Help provides help for any command in the application.
Type slipway help [path to command] for full details.

Usage: slipway help [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]...

Arguments:
  [COMMAND]...
          The command to describe, such as config view.

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h').

Examples:
  # Show the help of a nested command
  slipway help config view

Use "slipway --help" for a list of global options (applies to all commands).
